services.name: immich-mcp
entrypoint: const http=require("http"),https=require("https"),crypto=require("crypto");const target=new URL(process.env.MCP_UPSTREAM);const key=Buffer.from(process.env.MCP_AUTH_TOKEN||"");const transport=target.protocol==="https:"?https:http;http.createServer((req,res)=>{const m=/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i.exec(req.headers.authorization||"");const got=Buffer.from(m?m[1]:"");if(key.length<32||got.length!==key.length||!crypto.timingSafeEqual(got,key)){res.writeHead(401,{"WWW-Authenticate":"Bearer","Cache-Control":"no-store"});return res.end()}const headers={...req.headers,host:target.host};delete headers.authorization;delete headers.connection;const u=transport.request({protocol:target.protocol,hostname:target.hostname,port:target.port||undefined,path:req.url,method:req.method,headers},r=>{res.writeHead(r.statusCode||502,r.headers);r.pipe(res)});u.on("error",()=>{if(!res.headersSent)res.writeHead(502);res.end()});req.pipe(u)}).listen(Number(process.env.PORT||3000),"0.0.0.0");
